methodology.per_run_statistic: median across 16 samples of per-step slowest-rank completion time
methodology.final_statistic: arithmetic mean of two run p50 values
methodology.forward_scope: training forward to device-synchronized output and routed X/gate-up checkpoints ready; tape live; includes per-call notify, weight packing and activation allocation
methodology.backward_scope: fresh forward untimed, synchronize and cross-rank barrier; backward to device-synchronized gradients ready; includes internal checkpoint release and temporary/output allocation; returned gradients live
methodology.excluded: initial persistent pools and IPC setup, trace/input generation, post-ready output reference deletion
methodology.clock_note: coarse timestamped clock samples intersect reported timed intervals (including post-ready release); not continuous coverage; no timing samples discarded

validation.autotune_validation: generated combined profile with dW1/dW2 = 2/2 compiled and passed EP8/EP16 numerical checks; production matrix still uses 4/1; no full search
validation.excluded_claim2_attempt: claim2_verify_* used command-line macros overridden by frozen profile, so it is not counted as a 2/2 validation
